notes.title: Weekly Renders for June'25
notes.notes:
[p]This one's a bit [i]personal[/i].
I have this main concept on how I create characters where how absence affects people, how it changes people, how's their reaction, what choices they make, what becomes of them and ultimately how they reconcile with that absence- or [b]do they ever.[/b][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/9aa8d248ae7ba2334396af3008b59e5b7194de49.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/70d5794c41507793dbe8e021939eec2657de2a36.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/66a19dabbd187e7e16642fcd445f5159a3cb406b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/b37764631a2b437af3703cb473c886f5cbf9c969.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/5d21ee33df325a6377b538d4cef2eb721bfadde1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/f3cd38415147a3948cbd43b6f09572ac4f39bd72.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/b262cc5a36db25db33e874731c17bdc6ec49e1b9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/9191a277a11824652f288f6f9448df8ca9c620f6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]
These are basically my [b][i]Before-After[/i][/b] concepts which I keep going back to to remind myself that the story might have politics, violence, morally gray choices but all of them stems from something very simple- that whatever I'm creating revolves around people first.[/p]

notes.title: Further Education Ep6 Coming Soon!

[h1]Hello fellas!- It's finally done[/h1]

Through failed renders and massive wisdom tooth ache [u][b][u]EP6 is finally complete![/u][/b][/u] It’s [u]currently being playtested[/u] by a close friend of mine who’s had my back since day one. Once he gives me his feedback and the green light, I’ll release it!

You’ll need to start a new game. I’ve completely torn apart the internal systems and rebuilt something way more expansive that will make the game much more capable of handling the story elements and things much more immersive!

[b]Old saves won’t be compatible[/b], but trust me, it’ll be worth it!

Thanks so much for your patience and your support- It means everything.
I can’t wait for you to try it.

notes.title: Further Education Release date changes.
notes.notes:
Hello fellas! I'll just get straight to the point.
The game simply doesn't have enough wishlists as of 17th May 2024.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872815/f0286b52ee72a117bca5cd2f59af91753f8e5315.png[/img]
I'm hoping to ramp up my marketing AND release with an additional episode than what I agreed upon.

Now the game will come with 5 episodes, instead of 4, which will cause a delay obviously.
The new release date is 12th of July.

That's really it fellas, I wish I had enough wishlists but since I'm working on a whole different genre and much different settings, I foresaw this response from my audience whom I'm still grateful for - but this only means that new people are coming in! My audience and fans are simply changing and actually are growing!
My Patreon used to do 90$ Average on before Episode 4 and I basically got pelted over at F95zone after the release BUT my patreon subscribers have increased and now I make 140$ on average ever since!.

That's it, that's the update and again, sorry for the delay.
